fix_commit_msg:
[prim_sha2_pad,rtl] Fix setting of digest mode when continuing

Prior to this commit, `digest_mode_flag_q` would remain `SHA2_None` when
the `hash_continue_i` input was set high.  The correct behavior would be
to update that register based on `digest_mode_i`, however, which this
commit fixes.

Signed-off-by: Andreas Kurth <adk@lowrisc.org>
problem_statement:
[prim_sha2_pad,rtl] Fix setting of digest mode when continuing

Prior to this commit, `digest_mode_flag_q` would remain `SHA2_None` when
the `hash_continue_i` input was set high.  The correct behavior would be
to update that register based on `digest_mode_i`, however, which this
commit fixes.

Signed-off-by: Andreas Kurth <adk@lowrisc.org>
rtl_diff:
diff --git a/hw/ip/prim/rtl/prim_sha2_pad.sv b/hw/ip/prim/rtl/prim_sha2_pad.sv
index 8684c3e54f..edb18efca4 100644
--- a/hw/ip/prim/rtl/prim_sha2_pad.sv
+++ b/hw/ip/prim/rtl/prim_sha2_pad.sv
@@ -341,9 +341,9 @@ module prim_sha2_pad import prim_sha2_pkg::*;
     else         tx_count <= tx_count_d;
   end
 
-  assign digest_mode_flag_d = hash_start_i ? digest_mode_i  :    // latch in configured mode
-                              hash_done_i  ? SHA2_None      :    // clear
-                                             digest_mode_flag_q; // keep
+  assign digest_mode_flag_d = (hash_start_i || hash_continue_i) ? digest_mode_i  :    // set config
+                              hash_done_i                       ? SHA2_None      :    // clear
+                                                                  digest_mode_flag_q; // keep
 
   always_ff @(posedge clk_i or negedge rst_ni) begin
     if (!rst_ni)  digest_mode_flag_q <= SHA2_None;
